purpose: Pin external standards and AgentOS normalization baselines without turning every process or awareness reference into a Product acceptance gate.
baseline_rule: Every selected requirement binds standard_id, version, source, atomic identity, applicability, and evidence. A process baseline or awareness cross-check is not a Product pass by itself.
extension_rule: Project context may add typed standards and stricter requirements only; it cannot remove, replace, collide with, or weaken a pinned baseline.
